body.message:
Hi,

I am following up again regarding the AED 2,000 deposit refund.

This refund has been delayed for too long, and each time I follow up, I receive a different explanation. I was first told the refund had been processed to my card, then later informed that the transaction was unsuccessful and that a bank transfer would be arranged.

I have already provided all required bank details for a local UAE transfer to my Mashreq Bank account.

Please treat this as urgent and confirm today when the refund will be transferred. Once processed, please also share the transaction reference number.

I would appreciate your immediate action to close this matter without any further delay.

Thank you.
